subject.title: Feishu: @mention not recognized in group when multiple bots share the same group (open_id app-scoped mismatch)

question: Which Feishu identity source should OpenClaw use for multi-bot @mention recognition when WebSocket mention open_id values are scoped to another app?
rationale: The bug is source-reproducible, but union_id availability is disputed and the identity choice can suppress or misroute Feishu group messages.

options.title: Repair The Linked PR
options.body: Rework https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/40782 on current main and require proof that the selected identity field exists in real Feishu bot/group payloads.

options.title: Replace With Alias Mapping
options.body: Open a narrower replacement that maps known cross-app mention open_id variants without relying on unavailable bot union_id data, then close the stale PR after replacement exists.

options.title: Document Unsupported For Now
options.body: Leave require-mention behavior unchanged and document this Feishu multi-bot limitation until a stable identity contract is confirmed.

recommendation.title: Repair The Linked PR
recommendation.body: Rework https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/40782 on current main and require proof that the selected identity field exists in real Feishu bot/group payloads.

likelyOwner.reason: They are the live reviewer on the linked PR and current blame owner for the extracted mention helper.
